info.brief: Functions and constants for doing Myket in-app purchases.
info.description: Functions and constants for doing Myket in-app purchases.

elements.name: iapm.buy
elements.description: Start a purchase for a Myket one-time product.
elements.examples:
local function iapm_listener(self, transaction, error)
    if error == nil then
      -- purchase is successful.
      assert(transaction.verified)
      print(transaction.date)
      -- required if auto finish transactions is disabled in project settings
      if (transaction.state == iapm.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED) then
        -- do server-side verification of purchase here..
        iapm.finish(transaction)
      end
    else
      print(error.error, error.reason)
    end
  end

  function init(self)
      iapm.set_listener(iapm_listener)
      iapm.buy("my_iap_id")
  end

elements.name: iapm.subscribe
elements.description: Start a purchase for a Myket subscription. The result is delivered to the listener registered with set_listener. Subscriptions are never consumed, regardless of the auto_finish_transactions setting. An error is delivered when the installed Myket client does not support subscriptions.
elements.examples:
function init(self)
      iapm.set_listener(function(self, transaction, error)
          if not error and transaction.type == "subs" then
              print("Subscription active:", transaction.ident)
          end
      end)
      iapm.subscribe("monthly_vip")
  end

elements.name: iapm.finish
elements.description: Consume a product transaction. Call this only for consumable products and only after content delivery succeeds. Calling iapm.finish is required for a consumable transaction if `auto_finish_transactions` is disabled in project settings. Calling this function with `auto_finish_transactions` enabled is ignored and a warning is printed. The `transaction.state` field must equal `iapm.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED`. Calling this for a transaction whose `type` is `subs` is ignored.

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.doc: transaction table parameter as supplied in listener callback

elements.name: iapm.list
elements.description: Get details for the requested Myket one-time products and subscriptions.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.doc: table (array) of identifiers to get products from

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: result callback taking the following parameters

fields.name: self
fields.doc: The current object.

fields.name: products
fields.doc: a table keyed by product identifier describing the available Myket products.

fields.name: ident
fields.doc: The product identifier.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Product type, either `inapp` or `subs`.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: The product title.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: The product description.

fields.name: price
fields.doc: The price of the product.

fields.name: price_string
fields.doc: The price of the product, as a formatted string (amount and currency symbol).

fields.name: currency_code
fields.doc: The currency code, this reflects the merchant's locale, instead of the user's.

fields.name: error
fields.doc: a table containing error information. `nil` if there is no error. - `error` (the error message)

elements.examples:
local function iapm_callback(self, products, error)
    if error == nil then
      for k,p in pairs(products) do
        -- present the product
        print(p.title)
        print(p.description)
      end
    else
      print(error.error)
    end
  end

  function init(self)
      iapm.list({"my_iap_id"}, iapm_callback)
  end

elements.name: iapm.restore
elements.description: Restore owned, unconsumed products and active subscriptions. Results are sent to the listener registered with set_listener. Subscriptions are never consumed.

returnvalues.name: success
returnvalues.doc: value is `true` if current store supports handling restored transactions, otherwise `false`.

elements.name: iapm.set_public_key
elements.description: Set or replace the Base64-encoded Myket application public key used for local SHA1withRSA purchase-signature verification. Call this before set_listener, buy, or restore. Prefer the `iap.public_key` game.project setting so the key is available while pending purchases are processed.

parameters.name: public_key
parameters.doc: The application public key from the Myket developer panel.

returnvalues.name: valid
returnvalues.doc: true when the value is a valid Base64-encoded RSA public key; false otherwise.

elements.name: iapm.set_listener
elements.description: Set the callback function to receive purchase transaction events.

parameters.name: listener
parameters.doc: listener callback function. Pass an empty function if you no longer wish to receive callbacks.

fields.name: self
fields.doc: The current object.

fields.name: transaction
fields.doc: a table describing the transaction.

fields.name: ident
fields.doc: The product identifier.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Transaction product type, either `inapp` or `subs`.

fields.name: state
fields.doc:
The transaction state. One of the following
- `iapm.TRANS_STATE_FAILED`
- `iapm.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED`
- `iapm.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASING`
- `iapm.TRANS_STATE_RESTORED`
- `iapm.TRANS_STATE_UNVERIFIED`

fields.name: date
fields.doc: The date and time for the transaction.

fields.name: trans_ident
fields.doc: The transaction identifier. This field is only set when `state` is `TRANS_STATE_RESTORED`, `TRANS_STATE_UNVERIFIED` or `TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED`.

fields.name: receipt
fields.doc: The transaction receipt. This field is only set when `state` is `TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED` or `TRANS_STATE_UNVERIFIED`.

fields.name: signature
fields.doc: The Myket signature for the raw receipt. It has already passed local verification; verify it again on a trusted server before granting valuable content.

fields.name: verified
fields.doc: true when the receipt signature passed local verification. Transactions with an invalid signature are rejected and delivered as an error instead.

fields.name: error
fields.doc:
a table containing error information. `nil` if there is no error. `error` - the error message. `reason` - the reason for the error, value can be one of the following constants
- `iapm.REASON_UNSPECIFIED`
- `iapm.REASON_USER_CANCELED`

elements.name: iapm.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASING
elements.brief: transaction purchasing state This is an intermediate mode followed by TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED. Store provider support dependent.
elements.description: transaction purchasing state This is an intermediate mode followed by TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED. Store provider support dependent.

elements.name: iapm.TRANS_STATE_RESTORED
elements.brief: transaction restored state This is only available on store providers supporting restoring purchases.
elements.description: transaction restored state This is only available on store providers supporting restoring purchases.

elements.name: iapm.TRANS_STATE_UNVERIFIED
elements.brief: transaction unverified state, requires verification of purchase
elements.description: transaction unverified state, requires verification of purchase
